notes.title: Notice from Producer K
notes.content:
Hey, ninjas! Producer K in the house with some helpful information regarding our Cookie Collection Chronicles events!

1. First of all, you can access these events by clicking on our ongoing events banner. You can also access them by clicking on Menu and then the Chronicles button.
2. Regarding the time period for a Cookie Collection Chronicles event, 1 event lasts for 7 days. However, you can continue with the same score as long as you don’t pick a different Chronicles event the next time you play.
3. We will not be implementing boosts during our Chronicles events. Furthermore, you will not receive double Cookies even if you play a Chronicles event during a regular Cookie Collection event boost.
4. There are no ranking rewards in Cookie Collection Chronicles events. In exchange, past ranking awards are now rewarded when you reach a certain amount of total Cookies.
5. Cookie Collection Chronicles events require special tickets. We are planning on giving these out in a variety of ways, such as for event rewards and special occasions, so be on the lookout for them!

As I have touched upon before, the scores are a little high for some of the items given out as event rewards in the past. This is in consideration for the players who spent lots of resources and time in the past to get them. Please also note that we are prioritizing the release of older past Cookie Collection events (events 6 months or older). Whether you enjoyed these events when they first came out, or are just now getting the chance to enjoy them, we hope you have fun with our blast to the past! However, please understand that we will not reveal when which events are going to be released.

If you have any questions about these Cookie Collection Chronicles events, you can find a ton of information by pushing the ? button, which is located at the bottom left of our Cookie Collection Chronicles event page.

Well, that’s all for me today! See you awesome people later!
